The BanQu API is organized around [REST](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Representational_State_Transfer). Our API is designed to have predictable, resource-oriented URLs and to use HTTP response codes to indicate API errors. We use built-in HTTP features, like HTTP verbs, which can be understood by off-the-shelf HTTP clients, and [JSON](http://www.json.org) for input and output.
